title: cephalanthus occidentalis subsp. californicus
intro: Cephalanthus occidentalis subsp. californicus, commonly known as California buttonbush, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include the potential to provide health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of California buttonbush include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal value.
